questions.question: My spec promised the answer detects when the mapping master changed between rendering the statement and asking. But D-0038 deferred putting the master version on the statement response, so today there is nothing to compare against — the server can only name its OWN current version, which detects nothing.
options: Close D-0038: pin the master version on the statement

questions.question: I promised ordinary data questions still work with a statement on screen. The grill shows SelectionExecutor has no pinned-batch input and bypasses the non-budget-owner suppression — so such an answer could silently use newer data than the screen, or show DUB's budget on another plant.
